# Lip Sync Video

> AI lip sync video generation for dubbing, talking avatars, and multilingual localization.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/): Create lip sync videos in minutes with a simple, powerful AI tool for ecommerce ads, TikTok clips, short dramas, lessons, and animated characters.

## Use Cases

- Turn one creator video into local channels: Keep the same face and delivery while replacing the voice track for each market. Build Shorts, TikTok, and YouTube versions without another shoot.
- Produce UGC ad variants without new talent: Reuse a proven spokesperson, swap the script or language, and generate market-specific ads for Shopify, TikTok Shop, and paid social tests.
- Dub vertical drama episodes market by market: Sync translated dialogue back onto the original cast so every episode feels native in each region without reshooting scenes.
- Go from upload to review in minutes: Use short-turnaround renders for news clips, product posts, training updates, and daily social publishing queues.
- Ship 30+ language versions from one asset: Pair translated audio with the same source footage, then publish native-looking versions across your priority markets.

## How It Works

- Upload Your Video or Photo: Add any front-facing video clip or portrait photo. MP4 and MOV are supported, and still photos can become talking avatars.
- Add Your Audio or Script: Upload an audio file, record directly, or type a script and choose an AI voice. The workflow supports English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, and more.
- Generate and Download: The AI maps mouth shapes frame by frame and renders a lip-synced MP4. Download watermark-free or share directly from the result screen.

## FAQ Anchors

- [What is AI lip sync video and how does the technology work?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): AI lip sync video uses deep learning models to analyze audio phonemes and re-animate mouth movements in a video or photo to match the spoken audio. The model identifies facial landmarks, predicts mouth shapes, and composites the animation onto the original footage frame by frame.
- [How long does it take to generate a lip sync video with AI?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): Most short lip sync videos process in under 2 minutes. Longer videos take proportionally longer and run in the background, so you do not need to keep the page open while every frame renders.
- [How does AI Lip Sync Video compare to traditional dubbing studios?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): Traditional dubbing requires talent booking, studio time, session fees, and manual lip matching. AI Lip Sync Video produces everyday creator, training, and marketing versions in minutes, with far lower production cost and turnaround time.
- [What video formats and resolutions does the lip sync tool support?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): The workflow accepts common video and image formats such as MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, and WebP. For the best sync, use front-facing footage with clear lighting and a visible face.
- [Can I use AI lip sync to dub videos into multiple languages for free?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): Yes. New accounts start with 20 free credits, and a daily check-in adds 10 more, so you can dub clips into multiple languages at no cost. For multilingual dubbing at scale, paid plans add larger credit balances, longer clips, and commercial workflows.
- [Is my video data kept private and can I use the output commercially?](https://lipsyncvideo.studio/#faq): Uploads and outputs are handled as user content. Paid plan subscribers can use generated videos for ads, client deliverables, social media, and branded content according to the plan terms.
